data.ruling:
The refutation stands on "Ambient range" and fails this function. It does not stand on "Current into a shorted port". There, the verifier corrects P2's found value V134, and the correction is right. It is not a failure of the part. The stock verifier returned "incomplete" with no refutation: every figure it read agrees and passes. TPS55285VALR is a fixed input (Research.md:48). By the Scope rule, a standing refutation is reported to the owner. The part is not re-selected, so no next-ranked part goes to new verifiers.

(1) Ambient range: holds. The requirement rests on owner values:
- 0 to 50 degC ambient: V7, "one range for the whole IO board" (owner, 2026-09-28, Research.md:567). P2 applied it as V116.
- A servo rail current of 4 to 6.35 A (owner, 2026-09-25; IOBoard.md:63, :343).
- The 8.4 V setting (IOBoard.md:342).
- The pack floor of 6.0 V (F9). IOBoard.md:345 requires R6 to check the converter from 6.0 V.

The lowest point, 4.0 A at 8.4 V from 6.0 V at 50 degC, has to keep TJ at or under 125 degC. That is the recommended maximum in SLVSI72A 5.2. The absolute maximum is 150 degC (5.1), and lifetime derates above 125 degC. The data sheet gives no IC loss figure, and no efficiency is guaranteed.

The nearest typical curve is Figure 5-3 (VOUT 9 V, TA 25 degC, 400 kHz). Its VIN 5 V curve ends at about 88.8 % near 3.8 A. I rendered it at 300 dpi and the curve ends near 88 to 89 %. Taking 88.8 % at 6.0 V gives 4.24 W of total loss. The inductor takes 0.33 to 0.57 W of it. Only conduction has a data sheet basis: typical RDS(on) of 14.5 and 15.5 mOhm at 6.31 A gives 1.17 W. So the IC loss lies somewhere between 1.17 and 3.91 W. At 50 degC the budget is (125 - 50) / 33 = 2.27 W on TI's 4-layer 2 oz EVM, and 1.58 W at 47.6 degC/W on the standard board (5.3). The resulting TJ spans 89 to 179 degC at 33 degC/W. The data sheet neither shows nor excludes a pass. P2's own record marks the check pass false. A pass that the data sheet does not show is not a pass. This concerns this function's operating point and ambient range, not the part's identity or lifecycle, so the scope is function.

(2) Current into a shorted port: does not stand as a failure of the part. "At most 6.35 A" is P2's found value for V134, not an owner answer: V134 is marked "for research" (owner, 2026-09-28, Research.md:694). No owner value sets a ceiling on short-circuit current. The owner's "its limit stops at 6.35 A" (IOBoard.md:343) holds as a register range: Table 7-3 gives 0.5 to 6.35 A, and the limit is enabled at reset. The verifier's correction of the found value is right, though:
- The data sheet gives IOUT_LIMIT accuracy only at the 1 A, 3 A and 5 A settings (4.7 to 5.3 A at 5 A, VIN 19 V, VOUT 5 V, Tj -20 to 85 degC). Note 1 says these are "based on engineering sample characterization". No accuracy is given at 6.35 A.
- OCP_DELAY 00b = 128 us (Table 7-4). The text says the delay "allows the TPS55285 to output high current in a relative short duration time". During that delay only ILIM_AVG bounds the current: 7 A min, 8 A typ, no max.
- V134's found value therefore reads "6.35 A target, with no tolerance given, and up to the average inductor current limit (7 A min, 8 A typ, no max) during the 128 us". It does not read "at most 6.35 A".

The stock verifier's figures agree with my own reading of the Scope and Held parts tables: held 12 against a need of 5, TI ACTIVE, and Digi-Key Active. Nothing about the part itself fails.
data.evidence:
SLVSI72A (April 2025, revised October 2025), fetched at 2026-09-29T13:21:18Z, HTTP 200, 4,317,800 bytes. Figures read from it:
- 5.1: TJ absolute maximum 150 degC, lifetime derated above 125 degC.
- 5.2: TJ recommended -40 to 125 degC.
- 5.3: RthJA 47.6 degC/W on the standard board and 33 degC/W on TPS55285EVM (4-layer, 2/1/1/2 oz).
- 5.4: RDS(on) 14.5 and 15.5 mOhm typical at VOUT 15 V.
- 5.4: ILIM_AVG 7 A min, 8 A typ, no max (VIN 8 V, VOUT 15 V, 400 kHz). ILIM_PK 13 A typ.
- 5.4: IOUT_LIMIT 0.8 to 1.2 A at the 1 A setting, 2.8 to 3.2 A at 3 A and 4.7 to 5.3 A at 5 A (Tj -20 to 85 degC, VIN 19 V, VOUT 5 V). Note 1: "Based on engineering sample characterization". TSD 175 degC typical.
- 6.3.16: hiccup mode.
- Table 7-3: IOUT_LIMIT 500 mA to 6.35 A, Current_Limit_EN 1 at reset.
- Table 7-4: OCP_DELAY 00b = 128 us, "allows the TPS55285 to output high current in a relative short duration time".
- Figure 5-3 (VOUT 9 V, FPWM, TA 25 degC), page 9 rendered at 300 dpi: the VIN 5 V curve ends near 88 to 89 % at about 3.8 A.

Derived from those figures:
- 33.6 W out at 88.8 % is 4.24 W of total loss.
- Conduction at 6.31 A is 1.17 W typical.
- The IC loss budget at 50 degC is 2.27 W at 33 degC/W and 1.58 W at 47.6 degC/W.
- TJ spans 89 to 179 degC at 33 degC/W.

Requirement sources, checkout e13f5f60d2e5:
- Research.md:567: V7, "0 to 50 °C ambient, one range for the whole IO board" (owner, 2026-09-28).
- Research.md:694: V134, "for research".
- IOBoard.md:63 and :343: "4 to 6.35 A" (owner, 2026-09-25).
- IOBoard.md:345: R6 checks the converter from 6.0 V.
- Research.md:48: the fixed input. Line 43: a fixed input that fails a check is reported to the owner, not re-selected.

P2's record (scratch FU-B1/P2-R6/return.json) marks "Ambient range" pass false and gives V134 as "6.35 A".
